parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.lead_score, c.custom_fields, c.client_id FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status = 'qualified' AND c.lead_score >= 50 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.contact_id = c.id AND d.stage NOT IN ('closed_lost')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'lead_assigned' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') ORDER BY c.lead_score DESC LIMIT 20

INSERT INTO deals (contact_id, deal_name, stage, probability, assigned_to, client_id) VALUES ({{ $json.contact_id }}, '{{ $json.company || $json.contact_name }} - New Opportunity', 'prospecting', 10, '{{ $json.assigned_to }}', {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}); INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.contact_id }}, 'lead_assigned', '{"assigned_to": "{{ $json.assigned_to }}", "reason": "{{ $json.assignment_reason }}"}'::jsonb, 5); UPDATE contacts SET lead_status = 'opportunity' WHERE id = {{ $json.contact_id }};
